meta.title: Yevheniia Chumak — Senior QA & Strategic QA Lead
meta.description: Independent QA consultant with 10+ years of experience. QA audits, test strategy, AI-driven automation, SAFe integration, and QA leadership for startups and enterprise teams.

hero.title: Quality that scales — strategy, automation & leadership.
hero.sub: Senior QA Engineer and Strategic QA Lead with 10+ years of experience. I build quality cultures, eliminate manual bottlenecks, and help teams ship with confidence — using modern, AI-driven approaches.

services.title: Services
services.sub: From QA audits to AI-assisted automation — I tailor every engagement to your team's real needs and business goals.
services.auditDesc: A thorough review of your testing practices, coverage gaps, and toolchain — with a prioritized action plan tied to business risk.
services.strategyDesc: Building a sustainable, risk-based testing strategy aligned with your product goals, team capacity, and Agile delivery cycle.
services.automationDesc: Modernising your automation stack with AI-assisted tools and techniques — reducing maintenance overhead and accelerating feedback loops.
services.agileDesc: Embedding quality practices into Agile and SAFe workflows — from sprint ceremonies to PI Planning and continuous testing pipelines.
services.processDesc: Automating daily QA routine tasks — reporting, triage, test data generation — so your team spends time on what actually matters.
services.leadershipDesc: Building quality culture from the top down — coaching QA leads, mentoring engineers, and helping teams own quality as a shared value.

cases.title: Real problems. Real outcomes.
cases.sub: A few examples of how I've helped teams move from quality debt to delivery confidence.
cases.case1Problem: A payments startup experienced frequent regressions at each release, eroding trust with enterprise clients.
cases.case1Approach: Full QA audit, risk-based test prioritization, and a regression suite integrated into the CI/CD pipeline.
cases.case1Outcome: Release failures dropped 70% in 3 months. The team gained confidence to ship weekly instead of monthly.
cases.case2Title: Cutting QA Cycle Time from 2 Weeks to 3 Days
cases.case2Problem: Manual testing was a release bottleneck for a growing platform — blocking deployments for up to 2 weeks.
cases.case2Approach: Mapped all manual cases, identified automation candidates, and delivered a Playwright-based framework with team training.
cases.case2Outcome: QA cycle dropped to 3 days. Engineers owned test maintenance, reducing reliance on a single QA bottleneck.
cases.case3Title: Embedding Quality into a SAFe Programme
cases.case3Problem: A scale-up transitioning to SAFe had no consistent QA integration across ARTs — quality was an afterthought at PI boundaries.
cases.case3Approach: Defined QA roles within SAFe ceremonies, introduced built-in quality practices, and automated routine reporting across teams.
cases.case3Outcome: Quality metrics became a standard PI objective. Defect escape rate dropped significantly within two programme increments.

about.title: Quality isn't a phase — it's a mindset.
about.p1: I'm Yevheniia, a Senior QA Engineer and Strategic QA Lead with 10+ years of experience working across startups, scale-ups, and enterprise teams.
about.p2: I'm passionate about building quality culture — not just finding bugs. My focus is on automating the daily QA routine, enabling teams to move faster without sacrificing confidence, and leading engineers to take genuine ownership of quality.
about.p3: With a background spanning Agile Testing, AI-driven quality operations, and SAFe at scale, I bring both hands-on technical depth and strategic leadership to every engagement.
